en.hubs.market.github.label: GitHub
en.hubs.market.github.note: Finds SKILL.md files in public GitHub repositories. Nobody reviews them; every skill is audited when you install it.
en.hubs.market.github.startHint: Describe what the skill should do, or name a repository as owner/repo.
en.hubs.market.github.noResultsHint: Try other words, or a repository as owner/repo.
en.hubs.market.github.rateLimitHint: Wait a few minutes, then try again. Signed-in searches get a higher limit: set GITHUB_TOKEN or run gh auth login, then restart skillshare ui.
en.hubs.market.github.tokenHint: GitHub only lets signed-in users search code. Set GITHUB_TOKEN or run gh auth login, then restart skillshare ui.
en.hubs.market.github.previewSub: Nothing is installed yet. This is the skill's SKILL.md on GitHub.
en.hubs.market.github.previewEmpty: This skill has no SKILL.md text to show.
